extraction: CrewAI tracing control plane: centralized observability for multi-agent crews. Tracks agent decisions, tool calls, token usage, latency. Requires CrewAI cloud or self-hosted control plane. Maps to our harness: we need observability but no cloud, no paid keys. unified-memory + delivery-gate logs provide local observability. CrewAI control plane = DIES (needs cloud/paid). But pattern — centralized trace store — survives as unified-memory project scope.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: pattern survives (centralized traces), implementation dies (CrewAI cloud)
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
